rules.statement: A single cause of action can encompass multiple incidents occurring over a period of time.
rules.supporting_quote: The learned District Judge had misdirected himself in holding that the averments in the plaint constituted several causes of action which were embodied in one action. The plaint refers to one cause of action against all the defendant respondents though various incidents which had taken place between 1955 and 1963 were mentioned. On the facts pleaded and proved in the case there was no misjoinder of parties and causes of action. The title deed was properly proved in terms of section 68 of the Evidence Ordinance. There was no issue as to whether the notary complied with the provisions of section 31(9) of the Notaries Ordinance and no questions had been asked from him regarding that when he gave evidence
